title: Psychological Disorders of Childhood and Adolescence
description: Examines research and theory in clinical child psychology and developmental psychopathology. Discusses a variety of mental health challenges with respect to their description, etiology, treatment, and prevention. Multiple theoretical perspectives are covered to understand risk and protective factors across childhood and adolescence.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of PSYC 366, PSYC 436.
recommendations: Prior course in developmental or child psychology, and prior volunteer experience with a community agency recommended.
